scenarios.instruction: Put page 1 in the fixture, flat. Whole page in view.
Tilt the page 20 deg about its vertical axis (lift the left or right edge)
Tilt the page 30 deg about its vertical axis (lift the left or right edge)
Tilt the page 20 deg about its horizontal axis (lift the top or bottom edge)
Flat again, move the phone 1.5 times farther away (raise the fixture)
Take the phone in your hand and hold it over page 1, keep still (1/3)
Take the phone in your hand and hold it over page 1, keep still (2/3)
Take the phone in your hand and hold it over page 1, keep still (3/3)
Bend the sheet over a book (about 5 cm radius), phone looking at it
